extDescription.message: Picks up your SoundCloud OAuth token from soundcloud.com's own requests so you can copy it, or send it straight to the Kodi SoundCloud addon.

statusVerified.message: Token captured and accepted by SoundCloud.

statusCaptured.message: Token captured, not confirmed yet. Browse soundcloud.com for a few seconds to confirm it.

statusRejected.message: SoundCloud refused this token (expired?). Sign in again on soundcloud.com, then reopen this window.

statusCookie.message: Found in the oauth_token cookie, not confirmed. Open soundcloud.com to capture the confirmed token.

statusNone.message: No token yet. Open soundcloud.com while signed in: the token is picked up automatically, then reopen this window.

needPermission.message: The extension needs access to soundcloud.com to read the token.

btnCopyFailed.message: Copy failed: select the token and copy it

kodiHelp.message: 1. In Kodi: SoundCloud addon settings > Account > Manage the OAuth token. Leave the window on "Enter token". 2. Kodi needs Settings > Services > Control > "Allow remote control via HTTP". Firefox: if this window closes when you allow access, reopen it and click Send again.

kodiNoKeyboard.message: Kodi's keyboard did not open. Open it with "Enter token" in the OAuth token window, then click Send again.

kodiSent.message: Token sent. In Kodi, press Save: the window shows at once whether SoundCloud accepts it.

kodiAuth.message: Kodi refused the user name or password (web server settings).

kodiUnreachable.message: Cannot reach Kodi. Check the address and that remote control via HTTP is enabled.

kodiPermDenied.message: Permission to contact Kodi was refused.

privacy.message: The token stays in this browser's memory and is forgotten when the browser closes. It only leaves the browser when you click Send to Kodi. Treat it like a password.

kodiWrongKeyboard.message: The keyboard open in Kodi is "$HEADING$", not the addon's OAuth token field. Nothing was sent.

kodiUnknownKeyboard.message: A keyboard is open in Kodi but its title cannot be read. Check that it is the addon's OAuth token field, then confirm.

kodiBadHost.message: Invalid address: type Kodi's IP, e.g. 192.168.1.20 or 192.168.1.20:8080.

kodiNoWindow.message: The OAuth token window is not open in Kodi. Open SoundCloud addon settings > Account > Manage the OAuth token, then click Send again.

kodiFocusEnter.message: In Kodi's OAuth token window, select "Enter token" (or open its keyboard), then click Send again.
